items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, this critical authorization vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer's account, gaining access to their authenticated context and private data. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Critical vulnerabilities in Amasty extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of extensions, with two critical flaws that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield reportedly blocks these critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique. Adobe released a fix in the Magento 2.4.9 pre-release branch by May 12th, 2026.
